name: laxis
description: Search and read your Laxis meeting transcripts and summaries in Claude.
long_description:
Connect Claude to [Laxis](https://www.laxis.com), the AI meeting note taker and voice dictation tool. Ask Claude to recall decisions from past calls, catch up on recent meetings, or pull a full transcript — all read-only, powered by the hosted Laxis MCP server.

After installing, the first request opens your browser to sign in with your Laxis account. Prefer not to use the browser? Paste a personal API key (app.laxis.tech → Settings → Claude (MCP)) in the extension settings instead.

api_key.title: Personal API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to sign in with your browser (recommended). Or paste a key from app.laxis.tech → Settings → Claude (MCP) to connect without browser sign-in.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: Browse your recent meetings — title, date, duration, status, and a short summary.

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Semantic search across your transcripts; returns the most relevant snippets.

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Full details for one meeting — participants, AI summary points, and metadata.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: The full, paged transcript text, formatted as [m:ss] Speaker: text.
